explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/245 with Freiman's positive answer: for infinite A ⊆ ℕ of density zero, limsup |(A+A) ∩ [1,N]|/|A ∩ [1,N]| ≥ 3 (computed in EReal). If 0 ∈ A, then A + A only grows while the denominator ignores 0, so the case follows from the positive-integer one. The early-N zero denominators are irrelevant, since A is infinite.
